## What?

A clear and concise description of the changes
proposed in the pull request.

## Why?

What problem does this change solve? What was the
motivation or context behind these changes?

## How?

Detail the specific technical modifications or
additions.

## Testing?

Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes
and provide instructions for reproduction if
necessary.

## Screenshots (optional)

If your changes include visual updates, provide
screenshots or a screen recording here.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow project conventions
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint:markdown` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds

## Related Issues

Link to any relevant issues or tickets to provide
context, e.g., "Closes #123".
